text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for infra-gpu-pool-high-latency (sev: 2). Oncall: @sanjay. Start: 01:34 UTC. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/3012345678 :rotating_light:

sanjay: I’m on it, joining bridge in 2. Spinning up diagnostic traces.

megan: FYI saw elevated p95 for text-gen nodes ~01:28-01:33. Might be autoscaler churn.

sanjay: infra-bot, post current pool sizes and recent scale events pls.

infra-bot: Current GPU pool: 24 nodes. Recent events:
- 01:27: scale-down 3 nodes (policy: low-util)
- 01:29: scale-up 2 nodes (manual override)
- 01:31: rolling restart started for kernel updates on 5 nodes

lucy: rolling restart might explain KV cache misses. Are requests being retried?

sanjay: Confirmed higher 500s from model-serve gateway and retried requests spiking. Applying temporary routing to avoid nodes under restart.

rachel: Noted customer-facing errors logged: 8 requests with 5xx to org-acme in timeframe. Customer support pinged.

tom: Snapshotting logs and saving to /artifacts/incidents/3012345678/logs.tar.gz. Extract commands:

```
scp ops@collector:/var/log/incidents/3012345678/* ./
tar -czf logs.tar.gz ./3012345678
```

sanjay: Mitigation: paused rolling restart, pinned autoscaler min to 30, and routed new requests away from affected nodes. Error rate dropped to baseline within ~180s. :white_check_mark:

megan: Good. Can we capture timeline + root causes and set postmortem meeting? I’ll start a draft timeline.

sanjay: Please. Quick ask: capture contributing factors into three buckets: infra (rolling restart + autoscaler), runtime (cache misses/evictions), and routing (retry storm).

rachel: From customer-impact side: ACME reported degraded UX for ~5 minutes, no data loss. Flagging for postmortem customer-impact section.

opslead: Action register kickoff — we need owners and ETA for fixes:
- Owner: infra team to prevent restarts during SLO windows (owner: tom)
- Owner: autoscaler policy tuning (owner: lucy)
- Owner: request routing hardening + backpressure (owner: megan)
- Owner: customer comms writeup (owner: rachel)

megan: I’ll draft the routing PR: add backpressure and circuit-breakers. Target PR by EOD 2 days.

lucy: Autoscaler tuning: will add hysteresis and cooldown. ETA: 3 days for config change + 1wk for monitoring.

tom: I'll add maintenance guardrails so rolling restarts respect “critical window” tag. ETA: 4 days.

rachel: I’ll draft a short customer note for ACME and get legal review today.

sanjay: For the RCA writeup — I started a skeleton in Google Docs: https://docs.google.com/rca/3012345678. Please add timeline entries and any logs/evidence links.

megan: Volunteers for peer review of RCA? I can review infra/runtime sections.

opslead: I’ll do signoff after peer reviews, target signoff >= 48h from now. Make sure to include metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, and retry counts.

rachel: Tagging postmortem meeting: Wed 15:00 UTC. Invite sent.

sanjay: Quick checklist for RCA draft:
- Timeline with exact events (scale events, restart start/stop)
- Evidence links (logs.tar.gz, traces, dashboard snapshots)
- Contributing factors list (with severity/likelihood)
- Customer impact summary + list of affected orgs
- Action items with owners/ETAs and verification criteria

megan: Added note to tracker: https://tracker.redwood.example/issues/INC-3012345678-actions

lucy: Also suggest adding a runbook change: mark kernel-update restarts as blocked during peak inference windows.

tom: Will update runbooks after infra changes land.

opslead: Next steps: RCA draft by tomorrow noon, peer reviews same day, signoff by EOD next day. If anyone needs more time, call it out now.

sanjay: Acknowledged. I’ll drop logs + command snippets into the doc and mark items done as we progress.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation confirmed). Duration: ~7m. Postmortem scheduled Wed 15:00 UTC. 

megan: Thanks team — nice triage. :heart:
